newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One, Thai Danu statement expected Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Finance One, Thai Danu statement expected Thursday.

text.p: Senior executives at Thai Danu Bank Plc were meeting on Thursday morning to discuss its proposed merger or takeover of ailing Thai finance giant Finance One, company officials said.
"I think we can expect a statement later in the afternoon, executives are meeting at the moment," said a Thai Danu Bank Plc spokeswoman.

Finance One had postponed a board meeting but officials met at a working level on Wednesday evening and the company was now awaiting the outcome of talks at Thai Danu, a senior Finance One executive said.
"I think the due diligence has finished but we are waiting for the negotiations and changing regulations, it depends on a lot of factors," the executive said.
"I think maybe the story will change but I don't know in what way. We should have some more news around 2.00 p.m. (0700 GMT)," she added.
Details regarding a possible share swap were not expected, the executive added.

Thai investors are awaiting details of progress in the proposed coming together of the two firms as consolidation in the finance sector is a key element in the government's policy to bolster stability in the financial sector, analysts said.
The proposed deal, announced at the end of February, was said to have run into trouble in recent weeks due to valuations of the assets of Finance One -- Thailand's largest finance company.
The central bank said earlier this week that Thai Danu would acquire, rather then merge with, Finance One.
The merger would have been the largest ever between two Thai financial institutions.
